# Suvarnatantu

> Suvarnatantu is a B2B yarn and metallic zari manufacturing brand operated by Vastranand Private Limited in Surat, India. The website provides information for textile manufacturers, sourcing teams, distributors and export buyers about metallic yarn, zari yarn, technical specifications, applications, manufacturing capabilities, product development, samples and commercial enquiries.

Suvarnatantu focuses on clear product and technical communication for B2B textile sourcing. Important technical topics include yarn construction, denier, TPM, S and Z twist, metallic tone, application suitability, manufacturing, quality control and buyer-led product development.

For the complete set of indexable website pages, use:
https://suvarnatantu.com/sitemap.xml
